note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 2 June 1955 (round folder does not yet exist). Crumlin was the only contested division in Antrim Rural District (BT 1 Jun 1955 p6); every other division was filled unopposed or by deemed re-election, but no notice of result or full nomination list has been found in BNA. Mrs. Margaret McGregor 'who represents the Ballyclare Division' took her seat as one of four new members at the annual meeting after the 1955 election. A new member cannot be deemed and Ballyclare was not contested, so she was returned unopposed. Printed 'Ballyclare Division'. Returned unopposed. Uncertain: unopposed status inferred from 'new member' + Crumlin being the only contest; division printed 'Ballyclare Division' (the repo's 'Ballyclare Rural').
